newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - September 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - September 2.

text.p: Government officials in north say students and public servants need permission to come into army-held areas from rebel-held north.
Army detains 24 people, including children, at Pesalai, in Mannar, while trying to go by boat to Tamil Nadu in south India.
Japan to grant 750 million rupees to improve Sri Lanka's food production and help thousands of farmers.
Government ratifies Optional Protocol to the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, Foreign Ministry says.
Education Ministry spokesman says 40 percent of school children in northern Jaffna have returned to school.
Two people killed in clash between ruling People's Alliance and opposition United National Party supporters in Negombo.
Seven soldiers protecting farmers killed in Tamil rebel ambush in Ridipokuna in Polonnaruwa.
British Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind says international community appreciates Sri Lanka's efforts to protect human rights.
